mapper.select:
select bdscd.date, bdscd.week_begin, bdscd.week_end, bdscd.month, bdscd.quarter, bdscd.year, bdscd.value, bdscd.custom_id from bi_data_source_custom_detail bdscd
and bdscd.custom_id in
#{item}
order by bdscd.quarter, bdscd.month , case bdscd.week_begin when '' then bdscd.week_begin else to_char(concat(bdscd.year,'-',replace(replace(bdscd.week_begin, '月', '-'),'日',''))::timestamp,'MM-dd') end , bdscd.date, bdscd.id
